answer: Give every agent a kernel of non-transferable work credits that only grows by completing paid tasks verified by counterparties. A new identity starts at zero, like a saffron bulb that yields nothing in its first season. High-value jobs go only to agents whose credit vine has grown long through months of successful work, each task adding a link, each failure pruning several. A sybil attacker must pay the full cost of building that history for every fake identity, running hundreds of honest jobs in parallel, more than one clone could ever earn back.
